title: Leviticus Bible Quiz - Chapter 11
description: Ten questions on Leviticus 11: the clean and unclean land animals, water creatures, birds, insects and creeping things.

questions.text: Which land animals may Israel eat?
questions.explanation: Whatever parts the hoof, is cloven-footed, and chews the cud among the animals may be eaten.

answers.text: Those that eat only grass and green plants
Those that part the hoof and chew the cud
Those that live together in large herds
Those that have neither claws nor paws

questions.explanation: The camel chews the cud but doesn't have a parted hoof, so it is unclean.

answers.text: It has a parted hoof but doesn't chew the cud
It eats unclean food from the ground
It carries heavy loads for its owner
It chews the cud but doesn't have a parted hoof

questions.explanation: The pig has a split hoof and is cloven-footed, but doesn't chew the cud.

answers.text: It doesn't have a split hoof

questions.text: Which creatures in the waters may be eaten?
questions.explanation: Whatever has fins and scales in the waters, in the seas and in the rivers, may be eaten.

questions.text: Which of these is named in the list of birds that must not be eaten?
questions.explanation: The list of birds to detest includes the stork, any kind of heron, the hoopoe and the bat.

questions.text: Which of these is named among the winged creeping things that may be eaten?
questions.explanation: Of the winged creeping things, any kind of locust, katydid, cricket and grasshopper may be eaten.

questions.text: How long is someone unclean after touching the carcass of an unclean animal?
questions.explanation: Whoever touches their carcass shall be unclean until the evening.

questions.text: What must be done with an earthen vessel into which a dead creeping thing falls?
questions.explanation: Every earthen vessel into which any of them falls, with all that is in it, is unclean; it must be broken.

answers.text: It must be given to the priest
It must be filled with oil

questions.text: What stays clean even if part of an unclean carcass falls into it?
questions.explanation: A spring or a cistern in which water is gathered shall be clean, but what touches the carcass is unclean.

questions.text: What reason does Yahweh give for why Israel must be holy?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says, 'Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be holy; for I am holy.'
